This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [[Hachette Jeunesse]]'s [https://www.hachette.fr website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article. Fill in the required fields plus as many of the optional fields as necessary and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{Hachette|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://www.hachette.fr/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.

===Unneccesary parameters===
*{{Para|nolive}} As the original online content is no longer available, the template will automatically add "content now obsolete;" to the citation, and therefore does '''<u>NOT</u>''' require the use of "<code>|nolive=1</code>" like with other citation templates.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Hachette|url=livre/star-wars-rebels-16-retour-aux-sources-9782011801470|text=Star Wars Rebels 16 - Retour aux sources}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Hachette|url=livre/star-wars-rebels-16-retour-aux-sources-9782011801470|text=Star Wars Rebels 16 - Retour aux sources}}
